review_candidates.title: IBM BPM / BAW Developer
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Giza, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Overview IT Valley is looking for an experienced IBM BPM / BAW Developer to design, develop, implement, and maintain business process automation solutions. Work with databases, write SQL queries, and support data integration requirements. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve workflow and application issues. Collaborate with business analysts, technical teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Strong experience developing and maintaining enterprise workflow
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with IBM Business Process Manager (IBM BPM) and IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW), preferably within the banking or financial services sector. Work with databases, write SQL queries, and support data integration requirements. Collaborate with business analysts, technical teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Mandatory hands-on experience with IBM BPM 8.6.7 and IBM BAW 20.x .
